title: Cylindrical cavity, radius 10 mm, 30 mm long, on an unstructured mesh: TE111 and TM010
source: Cylindrical cavity resonances f = c/(2π) √((x/a)² + (pπ/d)²) with x'₁₁ = 1.841183781340659 (TE111) and x₀₁ = 2.404825557695773 (TM010), the zeros tabulated in M. Abramowitz, I. A. Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions, 1964, Table 9.5 (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., §6.4)

quantities.quantity: TE111 resonance, first of the pair (GHz)
quantities.reason: unstructured tetrahedra of 3 mm with flat facets inscribed in the curved wall: an O(h²) geometric error of +0.4 % (the elements' own error, as on the flat-walled box, is 1e-4)

quantities.quantity: TE111 resonance, second of the pair (GHz)
quantities.reason: as the first; the unstructured mesh splits the degenerate pair by 2e-4
